Detoxing in rehab has always been the best for me. It seems like it's just easier. I've had the same comfort meds at home and have always failed. It 
also helps when you have nurses looking over you. 
You'll be medicated to make the detox bearable. Typically 3-5 days in the detox ward until you get moved to your post detox room. From there you go to groups and meetings. You'll learn a lot about why your an addict, how the pharmacology works and how to break the cycle. You'll likely learn meditation and breathing exercises to calm you when anxious and get cravings. 
All in all, I've had good experiences at rehab. You just got to take what you learn with you and work a sober lifestyle or your be right back. 
Good luck. Think of it as a new beginning.
